4. A Sub-Inspector of Police Sheikh Abu Bakar (PW 19) was assigned with investigation of the case. He arrested some of the accused and in course of investigation, two of them, namely, Moniruzzaman Sheikh and Balayet Hussain made confession before the Magistrate. After completion of investigation, he submitted charge sheet against thirty accused under sections 143, 341, 326, 307, 302, 114, 109 and 34 of the Penal Code. 

 41. PW 19 Sheikh Abu Bakar, a Sub-Inspector of Police and Investigating Officer of the case stated that he had taken charge of investigation on 9-2-2012. He visited the place of occurrence, prepared sketch map, examined witnesses under section 161 of the Code, seized the alamats and sent accused Moniruzzaman and Belayet to the Magistrate for recording confessions. He also arranged recording of statement by Shohag Khan under section 164 of the Code. After completion of investigation, he submitted charge sheet under sections 143, 341, 326, 307, 302, 114, 109 and 34 of the Penal Code against the accused persons.
